title: Classic 7-Layer Dip
description: A classic dip with layers of refried beans, salsa, shredded cheese, and olives freshened up with fresh lime juice and homemade guacamole.
ingredients: 1 (4.5 ounce) can chopped green chiles, undrained
3 avocados, halved, pitted, flesh spooned out
1 cup salsa (drain to equal 1 cup if salsa is especially runny)
0.75 cup sliced canned black olives, drained
0.5 cup thin sliced scallion greens, green part only

steps.text: Mix beans, chiles, 1 tablespoon of lime juice, chili powder, cumin, and a pinch of salt in a small bowl. In a second small bowl, mash avocados with a fork; stir in remaining 2 tablespoons lime juice and 1/2 teaspoon of salt to make guacamole. In a third small bowl, mix sour cream and mayonnaise.

Spread bean mixture, then guacamole, then sour cream mixture, and finally salsa over the bottom of a 9-inch deep-dish pie plate or similar size pan. Sprinkle with olives, then cheese. (Dip can be covered and refrigerated up to 2 days) To serve, sprinkle with green onions.
